description: Computes estimated net proceeds for selling an Israeli home: agent fee with 18% VAT, legal costs, estimated mas shevach (25% of the CPI-indexed real gain, with the only-home exemption and its ₪5,008,000 ceiling), mortgage payoff, and other costs.

legal.description: Legal and closing costs in ILS (default 18000)

misc.description: Moving and other costs in ILS

mortgagePayoff.description: Remaining mortgage to pay off in ILS

onlyHome.description: Is this the seller's only home (default yes)

prepayPenalty.description: Early mortgage repayment penalty in ILS

taxes.description: Betterment levy or other taxes in ILS

name: sem.calc_seller_net_proceeds
title: Israel seller net proceeds calculator
